purpose: Prioritize claims that can materially change user-facing truth without overwriting history.
rules: Operating-state contradictions outrank low-impact metadata gaps.
Aging current claims older than 30 days receive a recheck flag when no newer source exists.
Planned infrastructure requires fresh operational confirmation before publication as active.
Community signals are rechecked for corroboration before promotion to fact.
Creator reach metrics are discovery metadata, never editorial quality scores.
